messages.content: You are a BPMN 2.0 modelling expert. Produce a complete BPMN 2.0 XML model for the process described by the user. Output ONLY the XML, nothing else.

The MPON reports the meter operation to the GO. The GO examines the application of the MPON. The GO rejects the application of the MPON or the GO confirmes the application of the MPON. The GO informs the MPOO about the registration confirmation of the MPON. The GO informs the MSPO about the registration confirmation of the MPON. The MPON and the MPOO perform the equipment acquisition and / or equipment changes. The MPON informs the GO about the failure of the entire process or the MPON informs the GO about the successful completion of the entire process. The GO informs the MPON about the failure of the overall transaction by deadline if after a maximum time limit no message of the MPON is present at the GO. If the MPON informs the GO about the failure of the entire process, the GO confirms the failure of the assignment to the MPON. If the MPON informs the GO about the successful completion of the overall process, the GO assigns the MPON. The GO confirms the assignment to the MPON. The GO informs the MPOO about the failure of the assignment of the MPON or the GO informs the MPOO about the assignment of the MPON. The GO informs the MSPO about the failure of the assignment of the MPON or the GO informs the MSPO about the assignment of the MPON. The GO informs the SP about the assignment of the MPON.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema" id="Definitions_1" targetNamespace="http://bpmn.io/schema/bpmn">
  <bpmn:process id="MPONRegistrationProcess" name="MPON Registration Process" isExecutable="true">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_1" name="Start">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_1" name="End">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Final</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    
    <!-- MPON Lane -->
    <bpmn:lane id="Lane_MPON" name="MPON">
      <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_1</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReportMeterOp</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EquipAcq</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_InfoFailure</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_InfoSuccess</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Receive_ConfirmAssign</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Receive_ConfirmFail</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Timer_Interrupt</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_CheckResult</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AppExam</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AssignResult</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_FinalMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
    </bpmn:lane>

    <!-- GO Lane -->
    <bpmn:lane id="Lane_GO" name="GO">
      <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ExamineApp</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RejectApp</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ConfirmApp</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_InfoMPOO_RegConf</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_InfoMSPO_RegConf</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_InfoMPON_FailDeadline</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ConfirmFailAssign</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AssignMPON</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ConfirmAssign</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_InfoMPOO_AssignResult</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_InfoMSPO_AssignResult</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_InfoSP_Assign</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
    </bpmn:lane>

    <!-- MPOO Lane -->
    <bpmn:lane id="Lane_MPOO" name="MPOO">
      <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Receive_RegConf</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EquipAcq_MPOO</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Receive_AssignResult</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
    </bpmn:lane>

    <!-- MSPO Lane -->
    <bpmn:lane id="Lane_MSPO" name="MSPO">
      <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Receive_RegConf_MSPO</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Receive_AssignResult_MSPO</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
    </bpmn:lane>

    <!-- SP Lane -->
    <bpmn:lane id="Lane_SP" name="SP">
      <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Receive_Assign_SP</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
    </bpmn:lane>

    <!-- Flows and Nodes Details -->

    <!-- Start to Report -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_1" targetRef="Task_ReportMeterOp" />

    <!-- MPON Reports Meter Operation -->
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReportMeterOp" name="Report meter operation to GO">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToExamine</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <!-- GO Examines Application -->
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ExamineApp" name="Examine application of MPON">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToExamine</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToGatewayApp</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToExamine" sourceRef="Task_ReportMeterOp" targetRef="Task_ExamineApp" />

    <!-- Gateway: Examine Result -->
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AppExam" name="Application Examination Result">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToGatewayApp</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Reject</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Confirm</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToGatewayApp" sourceRef="Task_ExamineApp" targetRef="Gateway_AppExam" />

    <!-- Reject Path -->
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RejectApp" name="Reject application of MPON">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Reject</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_EndReject</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Reject" name="Reject" sourceRef="Gateway_AppExam" targetRef="Task_RejectApp" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EndReject" sourceRef="Task_RejectApp" targetRef="EndEvent_1" />

    <!-- Confirm Path -->
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConfirmApp" name="Confirm application of MPON">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Confirm</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SplitRegInfo</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Confirm" name="Confirm" sourceRef="Gateway_AppExam" targetRef="Task_ConfirmApp" />

    <!-- Parallel Split for Registration Confirmation Info -->
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_SplitRegInfo" name="Split Reg Info">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SplitRegInfo</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToMPOO_Reg</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToMSPO_Reg</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToEquipAcq</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitRegInfo" sourceRef="Task_ConfirmApp" targetRef="Gateway_SplitRegInfo" />

    <!-- Inform MPOO about Reg Conf -->
    <bpmn:task id="Task_InfoMPOO_RegConf" name="Inform MPOO about registration confirmation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToMPOO_Reg</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToMPOO_Receive</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToMPOO_Reg" sourceRef="Gateway_SplitRegInfo" targetRef="Task_InfoMPOO_RegConf" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToMPOO_Receive" sourceRef="Task_InfoMPOO_RegConf" targetRef="Receive_RegConf" />

    <!-- MPOO Receives Reg Conf -->
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Receive_RegConf" name="Receive registration confirmation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToMPOO_Receive</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToMPOO_Equip</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToMPOO_Equip" sourceRef="Receive_RegConf" targetRef="Task_EquipAcq_MPOO" />

    <!-- Inform MSPO about Reg Conf -->
    <bpmn:task id="Task_InfoMSPO_RegConf" name="Inform MSPO about registration confirmation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToMSPO_Reg</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToMSPO_Receive</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToMSPO_Reg" sourceRef="Gateway_SplitRegInfo" targetRef="Task_InfoMSPO_RegConf" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToMSPO_Receive" sourceRef="Task_InfoMSPO_RegConf" targetRef="Receive_RegConf_MSPO" />

    <!-- MSPO Receives Reg Conf -->
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Receive_RegConf_MSPO" name="Receive registration confirmation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToMSPO_Receive</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MergeRegInfo</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>

    <!-- Equipment Acquisition (MPON and MPOO) -->
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EquipAcq" name="Perform equipment acquisition / changes (MPON)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToEquipAcq</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToCheckResult</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToEquipAcq" sourceRef="Gateway_SplitRegInfo" targetRef="Task_EquipAcq" />

    <bpmn:task id="Task_EquipAcq_MPOO" name="Perform equipment acquisition / changes (MPOO)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToMPOO_Equip</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MergeRegInfo</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <!-- Merge Registration Info Paths -->
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_MergeRegInfo" name="Merge Reg Info">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MergeRegInfo</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FromMPON_Equip</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToCheckResult</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MergeRegInfo" sourceRef="Receive_RegConf_MSPO" targetRef="Gateway_MergeRegInfo" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MergeRegInfo_MPOO" sourceRef="Task_EquipAcq_MPOO" targetRef="Gateway_MergeRegInfo" />
    <!-- Correction: The previous flow definition was slightly off, let's fix the merge logic -->
    <!-- Actually, Task_EquipAcq (MPON) goes to CheckResult. Task_EquipAcq_MPOO goes to MergeRegInfo? No, they happen in parallel after split. -->
    <!-- Let's restructure the parallel part slightly for clarity in XML structure below -->
    
    <!-- Re-defining flows for the parallel section to ensure correct connectivity -->
    <!-- Flow_ToEquipAcq connects Gateway_SplitRegInfo to Task_EquipAcq -->
    <!-- Flow_ToMPOO_Reg connects Gateway_SplitRegInfo to Task_InfoMPOO_RegConf -->
    <!-- Flow_ToMSPO_Reg connects Gateway_SplitRegInfo to Task_InfoMSPO_RegConf -->
    
    <!-- We need a merge point before checking result? 
         "The MPON and the MPOO perform the equipment acquisition..."
         Then "The MPON informs the GO..."
         So MPON task finishes, then MPON informs. MPOO task finishes, but doesn't directly inform GO in this step.
         However, usually these are synchronized. Let's assume MPON waits for MPOO or they just proceed.
         The text says: "The MPON informs the GO...". It doesn't explicitly say MPON waits for MPOO.
         But logically, if it's joint acquisition, they might sync. 
         Given "The MPON and the MPOO perform...", it implies parallel execution.
         Let's have MPON go to Gateway_CheckResult.
         Let's have MPOO path end at a receive task or just complete its lane part.
         To keep it simple and compliant with "MPON informs", we will route MPON to the decision gateway.
         We will add a dummy merge for MPOO/MSPO paths to clean up the diagram, though not strictly required for logic if they are side effects.
    -->

    <!-- Correcting the flow from Task_EquipAcq -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FromMPON_Equip" sourceRef="Task_EquipAcq" targetRef="Gateway_CheckResult" />

    <!-- Gateway: Check Result (Success/Failure) -->
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CheckResult" name="Process Result">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FromMPON_Equip</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Failure</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Success</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <!-- Failure Path -->
    <bpmn:task id="Task_InfoFailure" name="Inform GO about failure of entire process">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Failure</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToConfirmFail</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Failure" name="Failure" sourceRef="Gateway_CheckResult" targetRef="Task_InfoFailure" />

    <!-- Success Path -->
    <bpmn:task id="Task_InfoSuccess" name="Inform GO about successful completion">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Success</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToAssign</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Success" name="Success" sourceRef="Gateway_CheckResult" targetRef="Task_InfoSuccess" />

    <!-- Timer Event for Deadline -->
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Timer_Interrupt" name="Max Time Limit Reached">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TimerStart</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TimerToFail</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition />
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <!-- Note: In a real model, this timer would be on a boundary event attached to the EquipAcq task or a separate parallel branch. 
         For simplicity in this linear-ish flow, we'll assume the timer runs in parallel from the start of EquipAcq. 
         Since BPMN XML requires strict structure, I will attach a boundary event to Task_EquipAcq conceptually, 
         but since I can't easily modify the node above without breaking IDs, I will create a parallel branch for the timer.
    -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TimerStart" sourceRef="Gateway_SplitRegInfo" targetRef="Timer_Interrupt" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TimerToFail" sourceRef="Timer_Interrupt" targetRef="Task_InfoMPON_FailDeadline" />

    <!-- GO Informs MPON about failure by deadline -->
    <bpmn:task id="Task_InfoMPON_FailDeadline" name="Inform MPON about failure by deadline">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TimerToFail</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToConfirmFailDeadline</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToConfirmFailDeadline" sourceRef="Task_InfoMPON_FailDeadline" targetRef="Task_ConfirmFailAssign" />

    <!-- GO Confirms Failure of Assignment -->
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConfirmFailAssign" name="Confirm failure of assignment to MPON">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToConfirmFail</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToConfirmFailDeadline</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToFinalMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToConfirmFail" sourceRef="Task_InfoFailure" targetRef="Task_ConfirmFailAssign" />

    <!-- GO Assigns MPON (Success Path) -->
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssignMPON" name="Assign the MPON">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToAssign</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToConfirmAssign</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToAssign" sourceRef="Task_InfoSuccess" targetRef="Task_AssignMPON" />

    <!-- GO Confirms Assignment -->
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConfirmAssign" name="Confirm assignment to MPON">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToConfirmAssign</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToSplitAssignInfo</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToConfirmAssign" sourceRef="Task_AssignMPON" targetRef="Task_ConfirmAssign" />

    <!-- MPON Receives Confirmation (Implicit in the flow, but let's add a receive task for completeness in MPON lane) -->
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Receive_ConfirmAssign" name="Receive assignment confirmation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FromConfirmAssign</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToFinalMergeMPON</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FromConfirmAssign" sourceRef="Task_ConfirmAssign" targetRef="Receive_ConfirmAssign" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToFinalMergeMPON" sourceRef="Receive_ConfirmAssign" targetRef="Gateway_FinalMerge" />

    <!-- MPON Receives Failure Confirmation -->
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Receive_ConfirmFail" name="Receive failure confirmation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FromConfirmFail</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToFinalMergeMPONFail</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FromConfirmFail" sourceRef="Task_ConfirmFailAssign" targetRef="Receive_ConfirmFail" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToFinalMergeMPONFail" sourceRef="Receive_ConfirmFail" targetRef="Gateway_FinalMerge" />

    <!-- Split Assignment Info -->
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_SplitAssignInfo" name="Split Assign Info">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToSplitAssignInfo</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToMPOO_Assign</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToMSPO_Assign</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToSP_Assign</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToSplitAssignInfo" sourceRef="Task_ConfirmAssign" targetRef="Gateway_SplitAssignInfo" />

    <!-- Inform MPOO about Assignment Result -->
    <bpmn:task id="Task_InfoMPOO_AssignResult" name="Inform MPOO about assignment/failure">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToMPOO_Assign</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToMPOO_ReceiveAssign</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToMPOO_Assign" sourceRef="Gateway_SplitAssignInfo" targetRef="Task_InfoMPOO_AssignResult" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToMPOO_ReceiveAssign" sourceRef="Task_InfoMPOO_AssignResult" targetRef="Receive_AssignResult" />

    <!-- MPOO Receives Assignment Result -->
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Receive_AssignResult" name="Receive assignment result">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToMPOO_ReceiveAssign</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MergeAssignInfo</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>

    <!-- Inform MSPO about Assignment Result -->
    <bpmn:task id="Task_InfoMSPO_AssignResult" name="Inform MSPO about assignment/failure">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToMSPO_Assign</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToMSPO_ReceiveAssign</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToMSPO_Assign" sourceRef="Gateway_SplitAssignInfo" targetRef="Task_InfoMSPO_AssignResult" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToMSPO_ReceiveAssign" sourceRef="Task_InfoMSPO_AssignResult" targetRef="Receive_AssignResult_MSPO" />

    <!-- MSPO Receives Assignment Result -->
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Receive_AssignResult_MSPO" name="Receive assignment result">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToMSPO_ReceiveAssign</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MergeAssignInfo</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>

    <!-- Inform SP about Assignment -->
    <bpmn:task id="Task_InfoSP_Assign" name="Inform SP about assignment">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToSP_Assign</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToSP_Receive</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToSP_Assign" sourceRef="Gateway_SplitAssignInfo" targetRef="Task_InfoSP_Assign" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToSP_Receive" sourceRef="Task_InfoSP_Assign" targetRef="Receive_Assign_SP" />

    <!-- SP Receives Assignment -->
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Receive_Assign_SP" name="Receive assignment info">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToSP_Receive</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MergeAssignInfo</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>

    <!-- Merge Assignment Info -->
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_MergeAssignInfo" name="Merge Assign Info">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MergeAssignInfo</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToFinalMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MergeAssignInfo" sourceRef="Receive_AssignResult" targetRef="Gateway_MergeAssignInfo" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MergeAssignInfo_MSPO" sourceRef="Receive_AssignResult_MSPO" targetRef="Gateway_MergeAssignInfo" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MergeAssignInfo_SP" sourceRef="Receive_Assign_SP" targetRef="Gateway_MergeAssignInfo" />

    <!-- Final Merge Gateway -->
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_FinalMerge" name="Final Merge">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToFinalMergeMPON</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToFinalMergeMPONFail</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToFinalMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Final</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToFinalMerge" sourceRef="Task_ConfirmFailAssign" targetRef="Gateway_FinalMerge" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToFinalMerge_FromMergeAssign" sourceRef="Gateway_MergeAssignInfo" targetRef="Gateway_FinalMerge" />

    <!-- End -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Final" sourceRef="Gateway_FinalMerge" targetRef="EndEvent_1" />

  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
